title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: Matrix mix of Shnid 32352(sbd) and Shnid 116118(aud)

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording is a mixed bag but captures a high‑energy, loaded 1973 show with standout Truckin', The Other One and Eyes > China Doll performances.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the explosively strong set—especially the aggressive Truckin', soaring Other One and one of the best Eyes > China Doll transitions ever heard—while noting that the matrix mix swings between crystal‑clear moments and hissy, audience‑heavy sections. The show’s energy is high, but the recording quality ranges from excellent to merely fair.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (70% weight) and give 4‑5 stars, while recording quality receives mixed comments but still averages around a 3½–4 rating (30% weight). Combined score lands just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Inconsistent balance: some sections are crisp and blend SBD/AUD beautifully, others are hissy, audience‑dominated, or sound like a low‑grade audience recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Loaded, explorative set that builds momentum; strong second half with seamless segues and high‑impact jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice crackles on The Other One and his solo is described as "the very stuff of life."
band_member_comments.Phil: Takes control during Truckin', leading the band out over the horizon with powerful bass work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keyboard) leads The Other One to transcendent heights; overall keyboard texture praised.
